mentions.name: Rust EXI encoder/decoder
mentions.description: This is an EXI (Efficient XML Interchange) encoder/decoder written in Rust, aiming for both spec conformance and interoperability with other implementations, which currently don't seem to align.
mentions.problem: Spec conformance and interoperability currently don't seem to be the same thing for EXI implementations.
